adjudication.reason: only 1 stratum has at least 3 distinct sequences and a non-degenerate bootstrap, so no across-stratum comparison is available; the synthetic control is reported and is the only evidence this arm contributes.
adjudication.rule: consistent_with_memorisation if the lowest-homology usable stratum's peak-over-uniform bootstrap interval lies strictly below the highest-homology usable stratum's; consistent_with_general_mechanism if those intervals overlap AND the synthetic-repeat interval overlaps the lowest-homology stratum's; indeterminate otherwise.

id30_to_70_remote_homology.reason: 3 units is below the 8-unit floor; a percentile interval over so few atoms is narrower than one over many and must not be compared against another stratum's

id70_to_95_close_homology.reason: 6 units is below the 8-unit floor; a percentile interval over so few atoms is narrower than one over many and must not be compared against another stratum's

bootstrap.degenerate_reason: 3 units is below the 8-unit floor; a percentile interval over so few atoms is narrower than one over many and must not be compared against another stratum's
6 units is below the 8-unit floor; a percentile interval over so few atoms is narrower than one over many and must not be compared against another stratum's

lt30_no_detectable_homology.reason: no natural-repeat probe survives token alignment in this stratum

copying_matrix.note: the OV copying matrices are a function of the weights and the sampled token support alone and therefore do NOT vary by stratum; what varies per stratum is which heads that stratum's prefix-matching selects

covariate_analysis.response: mean attention of the arm's strongest induction head, per probe

no_text_arm: GPT-2's training corpus (WebText) was never released. OpenWebText is a reconstruction of the collection procedure, not the corpus GPT-2 saw, so a miss against it cannot distinguish 'GPT-2 never saw this document' from 'the reconstruction happens not to contain it'. No text-side homology stratification is constructed here. This control therefore speaks to whether the PROTEIN induction signal is general or retrieved; it cannot support a matched cross-modal memorisation claim.

probe_yield.note: a record without a probe is one whose two repeat copies tokenise differently on this arm; it is excluded from every stratum and listed here rather than silently dropped

strata.identity_definition: 100 * nident / qlen for the best DIAMOND HSP, i.e. the percent of the QUERY that is identically matched. Not pident, which is identity within the aligned region and would call a corpus fragment a near-duplicate of a longer query.
